cases.title: Card message header, three tags
cases.notes: RFC 082 v2.0 (§4.8): a card message's header: the title in the Card title style (CardTitle, 600), the subtitle muted, three tags as soft badges in their tone (danger, warning, neutral; info, success, neutral); no colour on the header itself. React-only: the mobile App draws card messages from the shared contract vectors (messageCard.v1.vector.json).

cases.title: Card message Fields, phone width
cases.notes: RFC 082 v2.0: Fields as raft-ui DescriptionList direction=horizontal on a phone-width card: below 384px each label sits above its value; values wrap, never truncate; mono values in the code face.

cases.title: Card message Markdown with a list and a quote
cases.notes: RFC 082 v2.0: a Markdown element drawn by the message renderer restricted to the card subset: bold, inline code, a nested list, a quote, a link; @name stays text (no chip); then a Divider and a button.
